title: Volt 20W USB-C Charger
subtitle: Voltaic · Model VC-20 (demo product)
summary: A compact 20 W USB-C wall charger for phones and tablets. This is a demonstration page showing how a QX opens a product.

facts.label: Output
facts.value: 20 W USB-C Power Delivery (5 V 3 A, 9 V 2.22 A)

facts.label: Warranty
facts.value: 12 months from the date of purchase

sections.title: Getting started
items: Plug the charger into a wall socket.
Connect a USB-C cable to the charger and to your device.
Charging starts automatically. Unplug the charger when the device is full.

sections.title: Safety
items: Use indoors only and keep it dry.
Stop using it and contact support if it becomes hot, damaged or smells of burning.
Do not use it to charge a laptop that needs more than 20 W.

documents.title: User guide
documents.text:
The VC-20 charger negotiates the best charging speed with your device automatically.

If charging seems slow, try a different cable. Cables that carry only data cannot charge at full speed.

Clean the charger with a dry cloth only.

faqs.a: Only laptops that charge at 20 W or less. Most laptops need 45 W to 65 W, which this charger cannot provide.

faqs.q: How do I claim the warranty?
faqs.a: Keep your purchase receipt and contact support with the model number VC-20. The warranty lasts 12 months from purchase.
